explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/303 with the Brown–Rödl positive answer: every finite colouring of ℤ has a monochromatic solution of 1/a = 1/b + 1/c with a, b, c distinct and nonzero. Working over ℤ (negatives allowed) matches 'the integers'. The result also holds for positive integers, so this is not a weakening. Formal proof linked.
